built.label: fig:pipeline-status
built.note: Four stages numbered 1 to 4 as Chapter 1 numbers them. Every number is read by key from results/accord/VERIFIED_FACTS.json (keys: gold.base_rate_299, gold.n_total, exemplar.rule_1_2_pooled_exemplar_correct_rate_in_299.rate, exemplardirect.defect_rate, exemplar_recomputed.rule_1_2_pooled.wrong_rate, c120.g299.n, c120.g299.n_flagged, c120.g299.mcc, c120.g299.ceiling_mcc, rulehead.test_rule_type_macro_f1, decontam.aggregate.ensemble_auroc, decontam.aggregate.ensemble_ci95_hi, sizectl108.power_curves.primary_crossing_power_0_80); no withdrawn key is readable. Stage 1 is marked not established (scarlet tint chip, dashed rim): the candidate pool's precision rests on an exemplar defect rate that three instruments disagree on (0 from the step2plus join, 0.4745 from the recomputed correctness check, 0.9315 from the unvalidated direct extractor). Headline: no stage's reported reading survived its check; the numbers themselves largely stand (AUROC 0.5145 is itself the bounded null), what failed is the reading of each. Stages 2 and 3 are labelled reading unsupported (solid scarlet chip): reading the weak labeller's 261 of 299 flags as discrimination is unsupported (agreement at chance, measured C120 MCC 0.0269 against the marginal ceiling MCC 0.0780); the three credited architectural contributions are unsupported by a code audit (initialisation artifact, rule-type target in the input, untrained harm head), no randomisation control run. Stage 4 is a bounded null (outlined chip): the detector ensemble AUROC 0.5145 with bootstrap upper bound 0.7034, under the C108 two-sided Mann-Whitney 80 percent power floor 0.7466. The scarlet carrier records that stages 2 to 4 consumed the exemplar stage 1 selected; it asserts shared input, not cause and not a defect rate.

built.label: fig:cohort-flow
built.note: CONSORT-style path from the source database to the two evaluated sets. Nine stages, four exclusions, every count read from a committed file. One exclusion branch the diagram would otherwise carry is omitted because no committed file records it as a count: the admissions dropped between the length-of-stay filter and the both-roles requirement. That is a difference of two committed counts and not itself a recorded exclusion, so it is not drawn. The admissions dropped between the both-roles requirement and the selected pairs are drawn because that count is itself registered: the shortfall is entirely on the nursing side, since a both-roles admission is selectable only when some nursing note carries a chart time strictly before discharge, and the discharge side carries no matching condition. The ambiguous count is the difference between the two positive counts recorded on the same 299 rows in the signal-check file, the same subtraction the prevalence figure performs. Four stages read the thesis register rather than a primary artifact, because their own upstream summaries live outside this repository under the data agreement.
